collectors.name: Ferrari — 80th Anniversary Art / Collector Experience

company.name: Ferrari
company.description: Luxury automotive and lifestyle brand approaching its 80th anniversary in 2027; opportunity centered on craftsmanship, legacy, collectors, client experiences, exhibition and possible charitable activation.

collectors.nextMove: Await Maria Conti's response; if no reply, send a concise follow-up reinforcing the 80th-anniversary fit and offer a short conversation rather than a fixed proposal
collectors.strategicValue: Potential flagship luxury collaboration with major prestige, global collector access, Ferrari client relationships, institutional visibility and premium revenue. Strong fit with Keegan's positioning around greatness, precision and obsessive craftsmanship.
notes: Ioana Hall sent the initial outreach from ioana@keeganhall.com on September 11, 2026. Keegan was intentionally not copied on the first email; manager-led outreach preserves positioning and brings Keegan in once interest becomes substantive.

Primary concept is NOT an art-car or vehicle-painting collaboration. The stronger lane is an 80th-anniversary original artwork and/or collector, client, exhibition, experience or charitable activation tied to Ferrari's legacy.
Positioning: Ferrari's 80 years of excellence, precision, craftsmanship and legacy align naturally with Keegan's hyper-realistic graphite process and most ambitious originals exceeding 800 hours.
Credibility used in outreach: Michael Jordan personally commissioned an original from Keegan and later helped facilitate another signed original through Upper Deck.

Credibility used in outreach: Keegan has an ongoing relationship with Rory McIlroy and his team across several originals and signed-edition projects. After Rory's Masters victory, Rory's team approached Keegan for a project in which Rory gifted the original to Augusta National and Rory and Keegan created an exclusive co-signed edition for Augusta National members.

Charity proof point used lightly: Keegan's work has helped raise more than $850,000 for charitable causes, establishing optional philanthropic activation credibility without making the initial pitch a charity proposal.

Keegan studied art abroad in Rome while at the University of Washington and traveled throughout Italy. This is authentic personal context to use later in relationship-building, not a primary cold-email credibility point.
Do not over-prescribe execution. The strategy is to show a compelling fit and invite Ferrari to shape the concept around what it is already developing for the anniversary.

Follow-up cadence: first follow-up around September 18 if no response; second touch roughly 10-14 days later only if useful, ideally with a relevant Ferrari anniversary/client-experience trigger; after that prioritize a warm introduction or alternate Ferrari marketing/events/lifestyle path rather than repeated cold emails.

Potential alternate paths if Maria does not engage: senior Ferrari North America marketing/events leadership; Ferrari Lifestyle; a warm connector with direct Ferrari client/brand-event credibility. Josh Rubin/Cool Hunting is a secondary connector, not the primary target for this traditional fine-art/collector concept.

latestCommunication.summary: Introduced Keegan in the context of Ferrari's 80th anniversary; established Jordan, Rory/Augusta National, charity and 800+ hour craftsmanship credibility; proposed an open-ended intersection around original art, Ferrari's collector/client world, exhibition or experience, and possible charitable component while explicitly avoiding a prescribed execution.
